title: Parse an age
hints: Write three guard clauses in order: empty, not a number, out of range. Each one returns `0, <error>` right away, and the happy path ends with `return n, nil`.
`s = strings.TrimSpace(s)` first. Return `ErrEmpty` as is. For the other two, `fmt.Errorf` with the `%w` verb wraps the sentinel so `errors.Is` can find it.
`n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); if err != nil { return 0, fmt.Errorf("parse age %q: %w", s, ErrNotNumber) }` and `if n < 0 || n > 150 { return 0, fmt.Errorf("age %d: %w", n, ErrOutOfRange) }`.
